name: SHIRMANI Product Passport Studio
short_description: Create a portable product identity, usage guide and QR-linked passport.
full_description: An interactive browser tool that builds a structured product passport containing a unique ID, category, short and full descriptions, usage guide, INR price, version, QR navigation link and explicit QC/dispatch fields. Exports JSON and supports print-to-PDF.
usage_guide: Enter product name and unique ID.
Add category, concise description, full description and usage steps.
Set the intended public price in INR.
Generate and review the passport preview.
Download the JSON or print/save the passport as PDF.
Use the QR to navigate back to the product page.
